hook: Most drivers can quote their rate per mile. Far fewer can quote their cost per mile.
body: Take one category — {{cost_category}} — and work out what it costs you across a full month, then divide by the miles you actually ran. Not the loaded miles. All of them. That single number is usually the one people are most wrong about.
caption: One cost category at a time is how you get to a cost per mile you actually believe.
cta: Rig Receipts — know what every load really pays.

slots.name: cost_category
slots.description: A single operating cost category, named plainly. Good: 'tires'. Never include a dollar figure — a figure here would read as a financial outcome claim and the slot check will reject it.
